title: data page: the generated filter bar includes single-value relation fields (lookup / master_detail / user) through LookupValuePicker, so Organization → Members → View all can filter by user (ruling F1 on objectstack#24815)
body:
**Filing gate ③: a task the maintainer set.** This carries out ruling **F1** on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24815: the maintainer's 「F1」 in the triage seat's chat, on the seat's re-boxed decision `6310115089`. Filed by objectstack triage (`session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader (who acts):** the objectui `domain:ui` seat, in one PR on the renderer of `ObjectDataPage`'s generated filter bar.

## Why

- **The gap:** an admin on an organization's detail page opens **Members → View all** and can filter only by role, not by user.
- **Why the old ruling (E′) could not fix it:** "View all" opens no declared list view (objectui#12741 deliberately anchors none), so a `sys_member` list-view filter would never be reached. The dev measured this (objectstack report `6309736149`).

## The shape (F1)

- `ObjectDataPage`'s auto-generated filter bar also offers **single-value relation fields** (`lookup` / `master_detail` / `user`).
- It uses the list view's existing `LookupValuePicker`: search by name, scoped by the caller's permissions.
- So **Organization → Members → View all → User** filter → typing a name gives one row for a member and zero rows for a non-member.
- **Not in scope:**
  - free-text search over the page (ADR-0061 Tier 2 stays deferred);
  - no objectstack metadata PR (the ruling voids E′'s "metadata only here" clause);
  - multi-value relations.

## Done when

- **The PR carries a browser measurement:** a member gives 1 row, a non-member gives 0 rows, on an organization's Members "View all" page.
- **Pins:** a relation field appears in the generated bar and filters by id, the picker honours the caller's read scope, and a non-relation page is unchanged.
- The objectstack console pin bump follows objectui's own landing flow.
